task_instance: Create a brand identity for 'Ledgerline', a self-hosted offline invoicing tool for freelance developers: run the skill's phases (positioning, competitive audit, brand adjectives, color palette, type system) and produce the core deliverable — a one-page brand brief plus design tokens as CSS custom properties, with WCAG contrast ratios on the palette.
evidence: Created sample_product.md as the user-supplied product input. Authored brand-brief.md (84 lines): positioning summary, brand adjectives + anti-adjectives, competitive-position call (break the blue/teal SaaS convention), full color palette table with hex+HSL+use-rule+contrast, two-typeface system with a 1.25 Major Third scale, do-not-use list, and shipability-gate checklist. Authored tokens.css (CSS custom properties: primary/secondary/neutral 50-900/semantic/background colors, font families, type scale) — verified braces balanced and 30 declarations. Wrote contrast.py (pure stdlib WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance + contrast-ratio + RGB->HSL) and ran it: it printed HSL and contrast-vs-white/black for every token and confirmed all six key text pairings pass AA (white-on-primary 6.02, primary-700-on-page 9.82, neutral-900-on-page 17.58, neutral-500-on-page 6.00, white-on-error 5.94, white-on-info 7.26) and correctly flagged the brass accent and neutral-400 as AA-large-only. The deliverable is the brand brief + design tokens, which exist and whose contrast claims were independently verified by running the script. Note: the optional Phase-3 'Design Intelligence' validation step ('python3 -m form_agent.uiux ...') is unavailable — the form_agent module is neither bundled next to the skill nor installed — and the skill's docs/output-kit.md formatting reference and the /atlas-report delivery command are likewise absent from the skill repo; none of these are the core deliverable, so the brand brief was produced without them (no replacement for the missing module was written). All work confined to the work directory; no network, no installs, no MCP/connector tools.
notes_on_missing_skill_pieces: form_agent.uiux module, docs/output-kit.md and the atlas-report command are referenced by the skill but not present; they affect only an optional validation step and output formatting, not the core brand-brief/design-tokens deliverable.
